horoscope: With the Moon's move to the top of your solar chart early today, dear Aries, your attention turns to your responsibilities, image, and larger life goals. This time of the lunar month emphasizes competency, ambition, and duty. Whether you want to be noticed or not, you're receiving attention. You can be pleasantly productive today, and a stronger sense of purpose and direction is building. Still, your personal life can interfere in spots today, or a disorganized feeling inside you may keep you from feeling fully efficient. The desire to push personal plans ahead can be strong, but be willing to take it slowly. As the day advances, your warmth and wisdom can be admired.

There can be some excitement revolving around finances, possessions, home-related endeavors, or issues of self-worth today, dear Taurus. Your ideas for making things work are clever. Still, you also stand to gain a lot through your dealings with others today, and you fare particularly well in one-to-one situations. Sharing beliefs and ideas can bond you, and your negotiation skills are better than usual. The Moon heads into your adventure sector, stirring your enthusiasm. Even so, as the day advances, you can become frustrated if someone doesn't see your viewpoint. Observing and learning from frustrations, rather than acting too quickly on them, makes a lot of sense.

There can be a nice win involving research, work, or finances now, dear Gemini, with your stronger inclination and ability to investigate and deduce. Your desire to produce and organize is strong, and you gravitate towards activities that improve your life in small ways. Self-discovery can be a theme now, even if you may feel challenged by distractions early today. How you respond to stress or demands for change can be an eye-opener. While you could be dealing with someone who is defensive and trying to prove themselves, you are likely to come out ahead of it. If you've been feeling undervalued, keep in mind that while compromise would be ideal, getting there requires people to meet halfway, and if that's not currently happening, save it for a more straightforward time. Let time tell the truth of a matter.

There is a stronger focus on partnership or one-on-one interactions today, dear Cancer, with the Moon's move into your solar seventh house. You might enjoy collaborating on a project or simply trading ideas with someone close to you. You are especially cooperative and may feel that virtually anything can be settled through negotiation. Still, you might pull back if someone seems to be trying to pull your strings as the day advances. Watch for a defensive manner, but pay attention to unexpected opportunities. Your energy levels are elevated, and you may feel motivated to take steps toward a dream or goal.

With the Moon's move into your sector of work and routine today, dear Leo, you can be ready to take care of details. This Moon transit is brief, lasting just over two days, but it's useful because it reminds you to get the primary systems in your life into better shape. Aim to handle some chores. Avoid unnecessary worry or frustration, and instead work on fixing problems, reorganizing, and otherwise tidying your life. Family or the desire to enjoy downtime can motivate you now. There can be some pressure building that gives you a feeling that you have to make quick decisions, but if you haven't done the research, it may be best to wait it out. However, it's a good time for sharing ideas with someone special.

Cooperation brings rewards and possibly some meaningful feedback in the first half of the day, dear Virgo. You're easing out of a brief self-protective phase, and you're approaching your world with more outgoing energy and desire for action. It's easy for you to persuade others to go along with your plans today. You can be drawn to communication projects or learning endeavors today, as you have a stronger sense of purpose and vision these days, and you're enthusiastic about pursuing recent ideas. As the day advances, buried problems may surface, and you can feel a bit riled up. However, it’s a strong time to see possibilities and make connections that you may have overlooked in the past.

While there could be a small letdown with money or practical matters, dear Libra, as the day moves forward, you are likely to be excited about a person, an idea, or a feeling. You can feel a sense of accomplishment or hopefulness in business, and in your personal life, a stronger feeling of security and connectedness. There can be a sense that you're growing and heading in the right direction with business or family, or both. Still, there can be some overstimulation or a sense of not knowing where to channel your energy at times today. The Moon's move into your home and family sector does prompt a real need for familiarity. You might thoroughly enjoy making purchases for the home or spending extra time creating a more comfortable domestic atmosphere.

You can have a frustrated response to what you feel is unfinished business, dear Scorpio, but there's good energy with you today for connecting with others in happy ways. The more likable, charming qualities of your personality are subtly enhanced as the Moon moves into your communication sector and harmonizes with Venus in your sign today. Your current ability to express contentment in the moment, patience, and optimism are in focus. Others notice your savoir-faire today, and they're especially attracted to your mind. As the day progresses, stay flexible and expect some schedule changes — or a change of desire on a matter.

This is a generally strong time for making interesting and notable connections through your beliefs, ideas, or studies, dear Sagittarius, as Jupiter, currently in your spirit sector, forms a creative aspect with Uranus in your partnership house. Today, the Moon turns your attention to your practical affairs, comfort levels, and money or things. The Moon heads out of your sign, and while its stay in Sagittarius helped you recognize your needs, it feels good now that you are more in control of your moods rather than feeling at their mercy. You are more inclined than usual to focus on the here and now. So while the day feels alive and fresh, you may be perfectly content to relax and breathe in this energy rather than forge ahead.

The tone is emotional today, with the Moon moving into your sign, dear Capricorn, and Mars in your opposing sign forming tense aspects. Others may oppose your plans or assert themselves in frustrating ways. Your emotions and personal needs are emphasized and may very well be worn on your sleeve! It's a strong day for self-motivation, even if it happens in fits and starts. Your feelings and emotional needs tend to surface now, and this can seem sudden and slightly overwhelming if they involve buried emotions. However, if you need to repair relationships with relatives or friends, this can be a good time to do so. Your own good humor and wisdom can be an important resource today.

With the Moon's move into your privacy sector, dear Aquarius, you may have a stronger need to hide yourself away, or at least to take a break from demanding situations. This process is natural at this time of the lunar month. It can be a time for behind-the-scenes activities, extra rest, and stepping back from competitive situations. It's an ideal couple of days to take extra time for yourself, look within for answers, and tap into your dreams, inner world, and intuition. There can also be new insight into business and financial matters, and conversations can be healing. Aim to learn from what seems to irritate you today and work on a plan to tackle it gradually. Patience will pay off now, but work-related issues may test it as the day advances. In close relationships, you may feel freer or express yourself more easily.

The Moon heads into your solar eleventh house today, dear Pisces. You seek out situations, goals, ideas, and people that/who make you feel good. As well, relatively easy energy is with you today for socializing and enjoying new experiences. You might gain an advantage through studies or news, and charm and diplomacy are integral to this. This can be a pleasantly passionate day for new ideas, opinions, learning, making connections, and friendships. Working with others cooperatively fares much better than competitive activities right now, but you are also very interested in growing and improving through your connections. You may be sensitive to apparent imbalances in your relationships or a lack of solid purpose. However, letting go of directing things can be useful, helping you appreciate the moments.
